name: @physics/engine
description: Deterministic simulation core: the pinned Rapier2D wrapper, Web-Worker host + SAB triple-buffer transport, dmath, the custom force and Gauss-Seidel constraint layers, analytics and snapshot/reset. The same core runs in Node for CI and replay.
_comment: Build posture is D30, set at P1: emit to dist/, test the emitted JS with
node:test, because ci.yml's `unit` job spans Node 20, which cannot strip
TypeScript. rootDir is the package root for the same reason scene-format
uses one — assets beside the code (here: goldens/) keep one relative path
that resolves from both src/ and dist/.
`./protocol` is a second entry point so the design-phase type files can
re-export the worker protocol without pulling the simulation core in with
`./geometry` is a third, added at P3: sim/rapier.ts imports the WASM at
module scope, so the barrel drags a physics build into any consumer — and
the builder needs 03 §5.3's shared geometry while in edit mode with no
world loaded. Re-exports only; no code of its own.
`./transport` is a fourth, added at P3b, for the same reason from the other
side: the §5.4 reader and the §5.5 interpolation rules run on the *main*
thread, which is the one thread that must never load a physics build.
Version 0.1.0 at P2b: 03 §2 defines engineVersion as this package's semver, and the golden hashes in goldens/state.golden.json are keyed to it. Anything that can change simulation output bumps it.
